about: Music and sound effects for videos 01 to 03, generated with ElevenLabs by tools/sound.py into out/sound/ (git-ignored). One channel bed for every video, played low under the narration and crossfaded with itself; a swell on each title card and a soft whoosh on each chapter card (video 03: each scene change).

bed.prompt: Polished modern cinematic tech underscore for a premium product documentary. Uplifting and confident, a sense of momentum and discovery: shimmering synth arpeggios, warm wide pads, deep sub bass, crisp tight electronic percussion with a steady four-on-the-floor pulse, subtle risers and airy textures. Instrumental only, no vocals, no lead melody that competes with speech, mid-range kept clear for narration. 110 BPM, consistent energy throughout so it can loop.

swell.prompt: Soft cinematic swell rising gently into a clean shimmer, subtle and modern, for a title card, no impact

whoosh.prompt: Very soft airy whoosh transition, subtle and clean, short tail, for a chapter card in a calm explainer video
